what: The FIRST fully coherent (12/12) performance suite on the stranger-daemon path — all-sm120 4-stage EU ring, reasoning-off serve default, think-split live, needle retrieval green 3/3 — plus the engine-truth decomposition that found the L1 draft-budget latch silently returning a ring to g=1 mid-session. Closes the 08-08/09 rehearsal arc (receipt stranger-hetero-suite-20260808 is the companion).

builds_under_test.c0mpute: master 3b66e49 (incl #62-#66: enroll/max-ctx fixes, drafter auto-download, needle reasoning:false, suite budgets + zero-visible guard, reasoning-off serve default)

ring.shape: 4 stages, all sm_120 (1x RTX PRO 6000 + 3x RTX 5090), 4 EU countries; the two 4090s parked to keep aux layers off marlin (see F_marlin_aux)

scorecard_client_medians_of_3.note: sim tok/s is VISIBLE-token count over the post-think decode window (upward-biased for the reasoning canary); engine truth below is authoritative for rates. TTFT is the honest user wait.

B_chat_reasoning_ON.note: the opt-in reasoning canary: TTFT = thinking time (20-56s), then the answer floods

D_longctx_needle.note: 6k prompt; warm prefill ~4s (one 95s transient); answers with just the code

engine_truth_two_regimes.mechanism: mid-suite one draft step exceeded the L1 draft-budget twice -> HybridDrafter.disable_eagle latched IRREVERSIBLY for the coordinator's lifetime; every later job ran plain chain. The scorecard medians blend both regimes.

findings.F_first_green_suite: 12/12 coherent across prose/chat/code/needle — the stranger path serves CORRECT answers end to end for the first time (07-28: first tokens; 08-08: first speeds; today: first correctness sweep).
findings.F_cot_leak_fixed: shard #171: the daemon path streamed chain-of-thought as user content on every reply (captured live); now split at the tools-seam THINK_END — content-only stream, reasoning as its own DONE field, settlement still pays all generated tokens.
findings.F_greedy_think_loops: under greedy decode, long-form thinking degenerates into loops ('We need to explain each change. We need to mention...') — 1024-1536 tokens of chain-of-thought with zero answer on prose/code. Serve default is now reasoning:false (c0mpute #66); chat closes its think reliably (905 chars) and stays the opt-in canary.
findings.F_marlin_aux_wedge_OPEN: an eagle:1 reset wedges a stage holding aux layers [1,30,58] on the marlin backend (Ada/4090): frames sent, no ack, stage silent, 90s first-ack watchdog -> P11 EAGLE-off restart. Reproduced twice with a 4090 head (aux layer 1); the identical ring serves EAGLE-off, and last-night's ring with aux on sm_120 drafted fine. Until fixed, 4090s cannot hold aux layers with EAGLE armed — the planner does not know this (it seated a 4090 head twice by RTT centrality).
findings.F_L1_latch_too_sticky_OPEN: the L1 draft-budget latch (P0-#5) is irreversible per coordinator process: ONE transient slow draft step costs the ring its drafter until restart — measured here as a mid-session 17->7 tok/s cliff with no operator signal. Fix shape: re-arm per job (the budget still bounds each job's drafting).
findings.F_daemon_accept_low_OPEN: armed acceptance 0.74-1.70 vs 3-4.5 on K-tuned operator rings — fixed K=8 depth=4 daemon defaults leave ~2x on the table (K-routing per content class is the quantified lever).
findings.F_zombie_coordinator_OPEN: a coordinator from a superseded swarm survived head-reassignment and wedged its box's engine in the successor ring (no ack on the new ring's first reset). Churn re-forms move heads in production; the worker should stop CoordinatorProcess when an assignment makes the node non-head.
findings.F_pull_socket_flap: heavy first-pulls flap the daemon's orchestrator socket (repeated DEGRADED/re-form during load; the anti-storm debounce + 'ring still loading' deferral contained it). A daemon-side keepalive during fetch would quiet it.
findings.F_ops: 5090 supply healthy; 3 of 8 round-2 rentals were key-propagation duds (vastai attach + direct-endpoint SSH rescued 1 of 4 attempts; direct endpoints beat the ssh proxy); a 'failed' create can still open a billing contract — verify instances after every create.

next: leyten's residential 4090 join/swap on this warm ring (churn + NAT admission), then the go-live checklist (npm 3.0.0, offline-key manifest, relays, payouts).
